narrative.headline: 2019 Subaru Forester: cracked windshields lead the complaints, with electrical and engine issues close behind
narrative.summary: Of 831 owner complaints filed with NHTSA, nearly half (45%) are about Visibility/Wiper, mostly windshield cracking. The next two areas are more serious: Electrical System (16%) and Engine (13%) each had 7 fires and 7 crashes reported. Smaller groups cite Forward Collision Avoidance braking and Power Train surging. Watch the windshield for cracks, and don't ignore any electrical or engine warning signs.
